answer.reason: The verses only mention Caesar as the one owed tribute, as the name on the coin and as a title invoked in accusations, and they record nothing he did or that happened to him.
doubts: MAT 22:17, MRK 12:14 and LUK 20:22 ask about tribute but state no deed of Caesar himself.
LUK 3:1 only dates John's ministry by Tiberius Caesar's reign.
